shots.content: Inside a dining room, a rectangular table stands between a sideboard and patio doors, with a window along one side. A man in a yellow shirt sits in the sideboard-side window seat and asks about the proper way to serve tea, a woman in a red shirt sits in the sideboard-side aisle seat, and a man in a green shirt sits in the patio-side aisle seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from the patio-door end, looking lengthwise along the dining table toward the sideboard, with both window-side seats and both aisle-side seats in frame.

shots.content: A woman in a purple shirt enters and sits in the patio-side window seat. A man in a yellow shirt asks her if sugar is preferred, and she answers that none is wanted.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the aisle side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: A man in a yellow shirt replies that everything is prepared after a man in a green shirt asks him if extra cups are ready.
shots.viewpoint: Top-down wide shot from directly above the dining table, centered on the tabletop, with both window-side seats and both aisle-side seats in frame.
